tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with the README and project plan to understand Resumsify's purpose as a career intelligence platform — job tracking, worklog, commute analysis, interactive resumes, and recruiter tooling.

tour.title: Database Schema
tour.description: The Prisma schema defines all core data models: User, JobPosting, WorklogEntry, WorkHistory, Resume, InterviewRoom, and more. This is the single source of truth for every entity in the system.

tour.title: App Entry Point
tour.description: The Next.js root layout wires up global fonts, metadata, and context providers. globals.css establishes the Tailwind design tokens and CSS custom properties. providers.tsx wraps the app with TanStack Query, theme, and session providers.

tour.title: API Layer
tour.description: Key Route Handlers illustrate the API surface: work-logs (CRUD for worklog entries), job-board (search + filter), and commute-matrix (multi-destination cost computation). Each handler follows the same pattern: auth check → Prisma query → JSON response.

tour.title: Business Logic Hub
tour.description: src/lib/utils.ts is the most-imported utility module — it provides class-name merging (cn), formatting helpers, and shared constants. src/lib/prisma.ts exports the singleton PrismaClient used by every route handler to prevent connection pool exhaustion.

tour.title: Worklog Feature
tour.description: The richest feature in the app. worklog-page.tsx orchestrates the three-pane layout (folder tree / note list / editor). worklog-editor.tsx embeds a Tiptap 3 + Yjs collaborative editor with slash commands, photo nodes, and canvas nodes. worklog-folder-tree.tsx manages the DnD-enabled folder hierarchy.

tour.title: Job Map
tour.description: job-map-google.tsx renders the Google Maps-powered job board with marker clustering. map-drawing-canvas.tsx and map-drawing-panel.tsx handle the polygon/freehand draw-to-filter flow that restricts job results to a geographic region.

tour.title: Interactive Resumes
tour.description: interactive-resumes-manager.tsx is the top-level orchestrator for the split-pane resume builder/viewer. adaptive-ir-editor.tsx provides the rich editing surface, while ir-anchored-popover.tsx and ir-popout-sheet.tsx handle contextual section editing without leaving the live preview.

tour.title: UI Primitives
tour.description: src/components/ui/ houses the shadcn/ui v2 (base-ui) component library — buttons, dialogs, dropdowns, popovers, and form controls. These are the atomic building blocks consumed by every feature component in the app.

tour.title: PWA & Service Worker
tour.description: public/sw.js implements a Workbox-style service worker with cache-first strategies for static assets and network-first for API routes. public/manifest.json defines the installable PWA metadata. pwa-register.tsx handles service worker registration and update prompts from within the React tree.
